assessments.reasoning: The reopened retained N3221 report assigns N3220 to C2y working-draft development and N3219 to the preliminary DIS stage. Its access discussion identifies the openly available draft as N3220 and connects the restricted N3219 ballot draft to the C23 work. This establishes the editor's identification of the documents at that transition.

challenge.method: Test the alternative that N3220 was simply the public copy of the C23 ballot draft.
challenge.results: The report gives the two identifiers different project designations as well as different access conditions. It supplies no comparison establishing byte or clause equivalence with the published 2024 edition.

limitations: The relationship does not establish byte or clause equivalence to the published ISO/IEC 9899:2024 edition.
The document status is established by the contemporaneous WG14 report. Textual equivalence to the later published edition remains unverified.
